terms.gloss: history: an account of the past, and its study
terms.comment: Greek ἱστορία, inquiry; in Latin the account of past events, and the past it records. The events themselves are rēs gestae (see event).

phrases.latin: historia vērō testis temporum, lūx vēritātis, vīta memoriae, magistra vītae, nūntia vetustātis
phrases.english: history, the witness of the ages, the light of truth, the life of memory, the teacher of life, the messenger of antiquity

phrases.latin: quācumque enim ingredimur, in aliquā historiā vestīgium pōnimus
phrases.english: for wherever we walk, we set foot on some piece of history

sources: Lewis & Short: historia · Lewis & Short: antiquitas
